caption: A glass electric kettle at a rolling boil clicks off, and the churning bubbles die down and the steam thins.

sa.check: A glass kettle is at a rolling boil.
The streams of bubbles from the base stop.
Steam from the spout weakens after the click.
The order is boiling, switch off, settling.

pc.expect: After the switch goes off the bubbling only eases and the water does not come back to a rolling boil, while the steam only thins.
pc.fail: The water returns to a rolling boil with the switch off; or the bubbling eases and surges in turn; or the steam thickens after the switch is off; or the streams stop and then start again by themselves.

pc.expect: The water moves only as the dying boil carries it and then settles, and the kettle stays on its base.
pc.fail: The water swirls or churns after the surface has settled with nothing stirring it; or the kettle rocks or slides with nothing touching it; or the switch moves back to on by itself; or the water churns while the switch is off and the base is quiet.

pc.expect: The switch acts on the boil: the streams of bubbles from the base stop and the surface settles after it, not before.
pc.fail: The streams stop before the switch has moved; or the switch goes off and the streams run as hard as before to the end of the clip; or the surface settles while streams still run from the base.

pc.expect: The remaining bubbles rise to the surface and the steam leaves the spout upward.
pc.fail: Bubbles sink from the surface to the base; or hang still in the water; or the steam sinks over the spout and pools on the counter; or the steam pours downward from the spout.

pc.expect: One kettle on one base; the water stays inside and its level changes only by boiling away.
pc.fail: Water passes through the glass; or the level jumps up with nothing added; or a second kettle appears; or the kettle changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The kettle's handle, its base and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The handle changes shape; or the base changes colour; or items on the counter rearrange.

note: The click is sound; it is read from the switch moving. How quickly the boil dies down is not judged.
